notes.title: Final Planned Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Doomsday Jetlag's finale planned big update! Here's what's included:

[b][u]🔥💥 ONSLAUGHT MODE 💥🔥[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qQsUa4t.png[/img]
New "Onslaught Mode" fight to the death above 6 huge new maps!


[b][u]🌍🌎🌏 GLOBAL MAP 🌍🌎🌏[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uVOox5z.png[/img]
New Global map added to the Onslaught mode with 23 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]🇺🇸⚔🇨🇦 NORAD MAP 🇨🇦⚔🇺🇸[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e66IKQW.png[/img]
New NORAD map added to the Onslaught mode with 20 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]⭐🇪🇺⭐ EUROPA MAP ⭐🇪🇺⭐[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t1lmvbK.png[/img]
New Europa map added to the Onslaught mode with 19 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]⚡🦘🇦🇺 AUSTRALIA MAP 🇦🇺🦘⚡[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O52bTtV.png[/img]
New Australia map added to the Onslaught mode with 17 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]🛰🔨🚩 USSR MAP 🚩🔨🛰[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fwQZ2gf.png[/img]
New U.S.S.R. map added to the Onslaught mode with 16 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]🌴🇧🇷🌇 BRAZIL MAP 🌇🇧🇷🌴[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qEZPHBN.png[/img]
New Brazil map added to the Onslaught mode with 12 cities & regions to protect!


[b][u]OTHER ADDITIONS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 4 New Songs
[*] Minor bugfixes and tweaks
[/list]


I also made a new trailer to celebrate the final major update:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZJUueRZVs5E


As always suggestions are very much welcome and thanks for playing!
Bug reports are also as always welcome and reviews are much appreciated!

Happy aerial hunting,
Cooper

notes.title: Update #3 - Sri Lanka, New Ability & more!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Doomsday Jetlag's third big update! Here's what to look out for:

[b][u]🌴🦁🛫🗡️🌴 SRI LANKA MAP 🌴🗡️🛫🦁🌴[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HG5nRny.png[/img]
Sri Lanka has been added as a new 'Easy' map. With 2 cities & regions to protect!

[b][u]ADDITIONS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Barrel Roll ability as suggested by community member MKfox! This ability temporarily makes the player immune to enemy attacks!
[/list]

[b][u]TWEAKS & FIXES[/u][/b]
Responding to community feedback, the following tweaks and fixes have been made to the game:
[list]
[*] Issue with speed control setting not showing correctly should be fixed.
[*] Card view area not loading properly bug fixed.
[*] Tasmania & Newfoundland ship navigation issues fixed.
[/list]

[b][u]FUTURE[/u][/b]
This was not initially meant to be a 'full' update so all the things listed in the previous update's future section remain the same here. Here they are again:
[list]
[*] A new game-mode with global map!
[*] Minor visual improvements
[*] More music!
[*] All-new 'Themes' to choose from in the menu that will shake up UI and map loadouts!
[*] Any bugfixes or tweaks as detected by me or reported/suggested by you!
[/list]

As always suggestions are very much welcome and thanks for playing!
Bug reports are also as always welcome and reviews are much appreciated!

Happy aerial hunting,
Cooper

notes.title: Update #2 - Hawaii, New Ability & more!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Doomsday Jetlag's second big update! Here's what to look out for:

[b][u]🌴🛫🌴 HAWAII MAP 🌴🛫🌴[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AU3tLe6.png[/img]
Hawaii has been added as a new 'Easy' map. With 3 cities & regions to protect, soar amongst the stars and be guided safefully from nuclear apocalypse!


[b][u]ADDITIONS[/u][/b]
A few other additions have been made!
[list]
[*] All new Stats tab on the main menu, track a number of different stats both per-map and all-together!
[*] Magnet ability! This new ability allows you to grab xp from further distances!
[/list]


[b][u]TWEAKS & FIXES[/u][/b]
Responding to community feedback, the following tweaks and fixes have been made to the game:
[list]
[*] Friendly jets no longer chase the player.
[*] Ships spawning incorrectly has been fixed.
[*] Issues with achievements and save file shenanigans should be cleared up!
[*] City rewards can no longer give negative amounts of cash.
[*] Cards have been made slightly rarer. Also a clarification on card achievements, they are only unlocked for winning a game with the cards active, not unlocking them.
[/list]


[b][u]FUTURE[/u][/b]
Some of the plans for the next and likely final 'major' update are:
[list]
[*] 1-2 new game-modes!
[*] Minor visual improvements
[*] More music!
[*] All-new 'Themes' to choose from in the menu that will shake up UI and map loadouts!
[*] Controller/Steamdeck functionality & localisations put on the back burner for now.
[*] Any bugfixes or tweaks as detected by me or reported/suggested by you!
[/list]


As always suggestions are very much welcome and thanks for playing!
Bug reports are also as always welcome and reviews are much appreciated!

Happy aerial hunting,
Cooper

notes.title: Update #1 - Philippines, Newfoundland & more!
notes.notes:
The first proper update for Doomsday Jetlag is here! Let's see what's new:

[b][u]NEW MAPS[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5H1DfbT.png[/img]
The Philippines has been added as a new 'Hard' map. With 6 cities & regions to protect, soar around the archipelago downing oncoming devils!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzJYQnv.png[/img]
Newfoundland has been added as a new 'Easy' map. With 2 cities & regions to protect, you'll be doing a fair bit of aerial combat in the North Atlantic building up your arsenal early-on.


[b][u]ACHIEVEMENTS[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jZ7Z5oB.png[/img]
In this version, you'll find 9 new achievements to unlock!
[list]
[*] 2 for victories in the 2 new maps
[*] 4 for building up a collection of cards
[*] 3 for surviving lengths of time in combat
[/list]

[b][u]TWEAKS[/u][/b]
Responding to community feedback, the following tweaks and changes have been made to the game:
[list]
[*] Bloom effect has been slightly reduced, particularly in menus
[*] The percentage of reward money you earn while Multi-Directional-Turret controls are active has been upped to 75% (Previously 50%).
[*] Speed controls can now be changed in the settings to the W/S keys instead of the scroll wheel.
[/list]


That's all for now, but what's planned for the future?

[b][u]FUTURE[/u][/b]
In the next update (releasing within the next 2-3 weeks) the planned additions are:
[list]
[*] Player stats accessible in the menu
[*] Map stats associated with above
[*] New abilities!
[*] Controller functionality
[*] Localisations
[*] Any bugfixes or tweaks as detected by me or reported/suggested by you!
[/list]
Beyond that, I have one major update planned, which I'm excited to get working on and report to you about in the next update release announcement!


Thanks for the support and thanks for reading!
If you like the game don't forget to give it a review, it helps me massively, and if you have any bug reports or suggestions, either comment them below or post them in the community!

Happy aerial hunting,
Cooper
